title: The Pottery Market
offer: The new kiln makes so many pots! Bring ten crates to the market in Kråkhamn. Ten crates: only your big boat can do it.

pots.name: Pots
pots.counted: {count|a crate of pots|{count} crates of pots}

steps.load_say: Pack them in straw: pots do not like to bump!
steps.say: Ten crates of Dagny's pots, and not one broken! The best rowing of the lakes.

fact: Clay pots were carried packed in straw, so that they did not break.
